summary: The terminal UI remembers content destinations across spaces, with back/forward navigation, Ctrl+A then t to open an agent terminal from its conversation, and Enter to attach detached terminal panes.

schema.detail: No database schema change; device-local workspace format 3 adds bounded navigation history and still reads formats 1 and 2.

compatibility.detail: Binding cutover: Ctrl+] no longer attaches a terminal; Enter attaches an already detached terminal pane. From an agent conversation in Fractal TUI, Ctrl+A opens agent actions, then t (Terminal) opens its terminal. The guidance correction adds no Attach control and changes no keyboard meanings. Ctrl+[ and Ctrl+] navigate with enhanced keyboard input. Legacy Ctrl+5 goes forward. Leader [ and ] navigate on all terminals. Attached programs keep direct chords. Older daemons still send attention text advertising the old Ctrl+] attachment shortcut or an Attach control until those daemons upgrade; follow the current TUI route instead. Saved-session conversation history survives workspace reopen and pruning; moved tabs restore in their current split.
